entry.title: Read basic Maximo detail fields through labels and visible date attributes
entry.description: In a fault-notice detail response, resolve each basic input through its label/for relationship rather than a recorded dynamic id. A date input may have an empty value while title contains the displayed date; use title before converting dojovalue in the MMIS local timezone. Duplicate labels can appear in the same response and must agree before one value is returned.
applicable_when: Reading readonly fields from a Maximo detail response
A detail form repeats labels in more than one section
advantages: Avoids dynamic component ids and extra navigation requests
Preserves the date the user sees in the browser
disadvantages: Conflicting duplicate labels require a fail-closed error
recommended_when: A detail response already includes the target input controls
notes: Match label text after stripping trailing ASCII or full-width colons.
Confirm the detail notice number matches the requested business key.
Validated against the 2026-10-02 basic-information recording and a live HTTP-only read of 1150910-14.
